findings.text: the done-when's ruff clause (docs/plans/additional-work-is-a-section.html:94) is measured nowhere: no ruff log, manifest line or fragment row records `ruff check` or `ruff format --check` on the changed paths, so the record cannot show the clause holds; rechecking at 160e251c2 gives 8 check findings at base and 8 at head with the new test file formatted, so the change is compliant and only the receipt is missing

the arms table names 160e251c2 as the head revision while the head arm's own log header reads '160e251c2 (plus this node's uncommitted changes)', so the recorded after_suite revision does not identify the tree that ran; the later commit 8c4e10c5b is docs-only, so the measured code equals the reviewed head's code, but a reader cannot prove that from the record

a comment still lists `follow_ons` among the prose list fields, so the rename leaves one stale reference to the retired spelling; the file is outside this node's write paths and the node reported outside_scope: none, so the coordinator never saw it

item_verdicts.diff: two commits read against 67cba14e: 160e251c2 changes two emitted field names, two ledger docstrings and one fixture key and adds a 118-line four-case test, and 8c4e10c5b fills in the evidence fragment's unresolved arm placeholders
item_verdicts.done_when: docs/plans/additional-work-is-a-section.html:94 asks four new test cases, a base/head delta over the importing test files and a ruff clause on the changed paths; the four cases and both arms are recorded (31 failing at base, 25 at head, no added ids) and the ruff clause carries no recorded measurement
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asks the three derived sites and the ledger docstrings to name outside_scope; reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:201, reckon/crew/dispatch_peer.py:407, scripts/check_snapshot_assertions.py:147 and reckon/ledger.py:632,651 all now name it
item_verdicts.manifest: the delivered record (manifest.md.attempt-1.asdelivered, status complete) reports the two arms, zero added failure ids, the negative control and the 284-file population; the live manifest.md has since been rewritten in-progress by a resume whose uncommitted edits are outside both commits
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares nine paths; both commits touch six files (reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_peer.py, scripts/check_snapshot_assertions.py, reckon/ledger.py, the new test, the evidence fragment) and every one is inside that list
